exposure: Ultrasound-guided measurements of the internal jugular vein (IJV)
cohort: 91 parturients undergoing elective lower segment cesarean section with a singleton pregnancy
finding: Internal jugular vein parameters, including maximum diameter, minimum diameter, and IJVCI during both spontaneous and deep breathing, were not found to be reliable predictors of post-spinal hypotension in pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section.
